name: SecretHunt
short: WoW-style secret hunts: hidden, personalised puzzles in forum posts, a Hall of Secrets, and badge roles for harder tiers.
description: Secrets of Wonderland. Each puzzle starts from a public poem whose first letters spell a hidden word. Saying the word starts a personal chain (every member gets their own variant, picked by a private salted hash): a riddle by DM, a pinned object to find and react to in the right forum post or channel, a morning-after jumbled word, and an answer sent back in DMs. Solvers are listed on the Hall of Secrets, one post per puzzle. Easy puzzles give no role; Medium, Hard and Expert each have their own role (with an icon on boosted servers). New puzzles are added as data and old ones never expire.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member, how far they have got in each hunt puzzle (stage, timestamps, their variant, wrong-guess counts) and, per puzzle, the ordered list of user IDs who solved it. The Hall of Secrets shows solvers' display names. It is deleted on a Red data-deletion request.
install_msg: Set up with `.secrethunt channels #post1 #post2 ...` (2 to 5 forum posts or channels), `.secrethunt hall #hall-of-secrets`, `.secrethunt setup`, `.secrethunt start late_rabbit`, `.secrethunt poem #where`, then `.secrethunt enable`. Try it first with `.secrethunt testmode on`. Easy has no role; set tier roles with `.secrethunt role <medium|hard|expert>`.
